file.description: Local image file to register as a measuring reference (CLI and MCP). Give exactly one of file or data.
file.title: File

data.description: Base64 image bytes for uploads (the GUI's file picker). Give exactly one of file or data; at most 5 MiB decoded.
data.title: Data

license.description: Usage terms of the image; use unknown when unknown.
license.title: License

rights_note.description: Who owns the image and how it may be used, for example 'third-party game sprite, measure only'. Do not write titles or URLs if the project may be published.
rights_note.title: Rights Note

placed_by.description: Who chose this image. Set by the surface: GUI uploads are human-gui and MCP calls are agent; the CLI defaults to human-cli and accepts agent.
placed_by.title: Placed By

expect_revision.description: Reject if the current revision differs.
expect_revision.title: Expect Revision

idempotency_key.description: Replay a prior result for this transaction key.
idempotency_key.title: Idempotency Key

preview.description: Return no preview, PNG paths, or inline PNG images.
preview.title: Preview
